description: This Java class provides utility methods for computing the MD5 checksum of a file given its filename. It includes methods to generate the checksum as a byte array and as a hexadecimal string.

classes.name: MD5Checksum
classes.description: Utility class for creating MD5 checksum hashes of files, primarily used for verifying file integrity.

methods.name: createChecksum
methods.description: Calculates and returns the MD5 checksum of a file specified by its filename as a byte array.

methods.name: getMD5Checksum
methods.description: Returns the MD5 checksum of a file as a hexadecimal string.
